name: SC-001: Successful Login Redirects to Inventory
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Products page logo or header area, and verify the Products heading is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, and verify the Products heading is visible.

name: SC-002: Cart Badge Updates on Add to Cart
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the shopping cart badge displays 1.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the cart badge shows 1.

name: SC-003: Cart Icon Navigates to Cart Page
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the cart icon, and verify the Your Cart heading is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the shopping cart icon, and verify the Your Cart heading is visible.

name: SC-004: Sort Price Low to High Shows Cheapest First
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown, and verify the price $7.99 is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown, and verify the price $7.99 is visible.

name: SC-005: Product Name Click Opens Detail Page
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Sauce Labs Backpack product name, and verify the Back to products button is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the product name Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the Add to cart button is visible on the product detail page.
